description: The full Fragrance Index profile of one perfume, cologne or fragrance: house, launch year, audience, concentration, family, accords, note pyramid (top, heart and base notes), best seasons and occasions, longevity, projection and perfumers (full profiles), the editors' character description, five similar perfumes, editorial alternatives from other houses when they exist, related 10ML guides and links. Use when you know which perfume is meant and need facts about it ('tell me about Aventus', 'what notes are in Delina', 'what does Baccarat Rouge 540 smell like'). Not for browsing (use search_perfumes), not for comparing two or more (use compare_perfumes). Unknown names return the closest matches.

house.description: House, when the name alone is ambiguous. Example: "Creed"

locale.description: Language of the 10ml.com links and labels.

perfume.description: A perfume by name, optionally with its house, e.g. "Baccarat Rouge 540", "Dior Sauvage", "Delina". An id from another tool also works, e.g. "creed-aventus".

response_format.description: concise (default) or detailed (adds pyramid, seasons, occasions, longevity).

name: get_perfume
title: Get perfume profile
